inboxRecovery.remainingReviewHelp: This review approves only currently known values. Steps depending on a later integration result stay held for another review. Current permissions and dispatch controls are checked again when work runs.
inboxRecovery.sendSkipped: No customer reply is reserved for this sequence. The authored reply is shown for context and will be skipped. This review cannot create a new reply reservation.
inboxRecovery.retryHelp: A permitted retry uses the original operation, exact request and fixed provider idempotency guarantee. It never creates a replacement operation or enables dispatch.
inboxRecovery.cancelHelp: Stop remaining workflow steps without retracting accepted requests, erasing results or resolving an uncertain submission.
inboxRecovery.reasonHelp: Use a single-line summary, up to 1,000 characters. Keep credentials, raw payloads and secret URLs out of this audit record.
inboxRecovery.reasonError: Enter one line, up to 1,000 characters, without line breaks or control characters.

inboxRecovery.preparationError: A secure decision could not be prepared. Review the current details and try again in a supported browser; no submission was started.
inboxRecovery.originalGuaranteeRequired: This preview does not confirm an original-operation retry. Ask your operator to check the provider contract; no replacement operation is allowed.
inboxRecovery.unavailable: This action is not currently eligible. Check the operation and current access before reviewing again.
inboxRecovery.unresolvedCancel: An earlier provider outcome is unresolved. Stopping remaining steps keeps that uncertainty recorded and still requires investigation.
inboxRecovery.inFlightCancel: A request is currently in flight. It can finish after the workflow stops; inspect its operation result separately.
inboxRecovery.unconfirmedHelp: The server may have accepted this decision. Its exact identifier and payload are kept. Check the recorded decision or resubmit this identical confirmation; do not create a replacement external request.
inboxRecovery.conflict: The confirmation conflicts with current state. Inspect the operation and recovery history, then explicitly request a fresh review if needed.
inboxRecovery.accessChanged: Your current access cannot confirm this decision. That does not prove an earlier attempt was absent. Ask an authorised operator to inspect its identifier.
inboxRecovery.closeBlocked: Resolve or explicitly review the unconfirmed decision before leaving. Closing it would lose the private confirmation needed for an identical retry.
inboxRecovery.recordLookupError: The recovery history could not be read. Your pending decision is kept. Retry the lookup; an absent record on one page is not proof that the write failed.
inboxRecovery.freshReviewHelp: Discarding this local confirmation does not undo a server decision or external operation. First inspect the operation and recovery history. A fresh preview rechecks current eligibility and submits no external request.
inboxRecovery.investigated: I have reviewed the current operation and recovery history.
inboxRecovery.freshReview: Discard local confirmation and review current state

reason.investigation_reference_required: Provide a safe investigation reference for the independently verified finding, then request a fresh review.

reason.result_invalid: The selected result values do not meet the current declared schema. Check each required value and request a fresh review.
reason.no_unhandled_success: No unhandled successful result is available. Refresh the operation and inspect its recorded output disposition.
reason.mapped_result_unavailable: This operation has no retained mapped result to apply. Inspect its recorded outcome; do not reconstruct a replacement result.
reason.result_unavailable: The retained result cannot be read. Ask an authorised operator to restore access before reviewing it.

reason.masked_output_requires_authorised_review: Phone masking prevents applying these selected values with this access. Use an authorised review route without changing the masking policy.
reason.not_retryable_state: The operation is not in a retryable state. Refresh its recorded outcome.

reason.idempotency_window_unavailable: A sufficient original provider idempotency guarantee is not available. Investigate the original request instead of replaying it.
reason.workflow_context_changed: The execution and workflow context no longer match. Ask an operator to investigate.
reason.case_changed: The case has changed. Inspect current values before any new review.
reason.workflow_changed: The workflow definition changed. This original confirmation cannot authorise changed work.
reason.action_changed: The original action changed. This operation cannot be retried as a different action.
reason.snapshot_unavailable: The original secure request snapshot is unavailable. Ask your operator to restore access; do not reconstruct a replacement request.
reason.input_access_required: Current contact access is required to review the original inputs.
reason.definition_or_values_changed: The approved definition or exact original values changed. This review cannot authorise a replacement request.
reason.not_a_sequenced_workflow: This run does not use an integration sequence.
reason.workflow_already_stopped: Remaining work is already stopped or complete. Recorded provider outcomes remain separate.
reason.message_submission_in_progress: The WhatsApp reply is currently being submitted. Wait for its recorded outcome before stopping this sequence.
reason.reconcile_message_submission_first: Reconcile the unknown WhatsApp submission first. Stopping must not conceal a possibly accepted message.

inboxIntegrationHistory.title: Integration operations
inboxIntegrationHistory.currentHelp: These recorded operation states are separate from the workflow snapshot. Requests, response bodies and credentials are not included.
inboxIntegrationHistory.snapshotHelp: Run snapshot — open Integration operations for the recorded external state.
inboxIntegrationHistory.cancelledHelp: Remaining workflow actions are stopped. An operation already submitted can still finish; stopping does not retract it or prove that it failed.
inboxIntegrationHistory.loadError: Operation states could not be refreshed. Any previous results below may be out of date. Retry before deciding what to do.
inboxIntegrationHistory.noExecutions: No integration operations are recorded for this run. This is not proof that remaining work is complete.
inboxIntegrationHistory.outputsPending: Successful result; output disposition not recorded
inboxIntegrationHistory.manualHelp: An administrator recorded this investigation outcome. It is a manual attestation, not a provider HTTP response.
inboxIntegrationHistory.unresolvedHelp: The external outcome is not yet confirmed. Do not create a replacement request. Investigate the original operation before any eligible retry.
inboxIntegrationHistory.retryHelp: This deadline alone does not permit a retry. Current permissions, original values, workflow state and dispatch holds must also pass a fresh review.
inboxIntegrationHistory.recordsError: Recovery records could not be refreshed. Previously displayed records may be out of date; retry to check the current history.
inboxIntegrationHistory.noDecisions: No recovery decisions are recorded on this page.
inboxIntegrationHistory.evidenceError: The reference could not be read with your current access. Retry to check it; no recovery decision was made.
inboxIntegrationHistory.evidenceRestricted: An investigation reference is retained. An authorised operator can inspect it separately.
inboxIntegrationHistory.outcomeOther: Review the recorded operation and recovery details.

outcome.needs_reconciliation: The submission outcome needs investigation before further action.
outcome.retry_window_expired: The original provider idempotency guarantee has expired. Automatic replay is held.
outcome.output_context_changed: The provider succeeded but the case changed. Review selected outputs separately.
outcome.output_access_changed: Output access changed after submission. Investigate the external result.
outcome.output_invalid: The returned selected values could not be accepted. Investigate the external result.
outcome.manually_confirmed_success: Success was recorded from an administrator's investigation.
outcome.manually_confirmed_no_effect: An administrator recorded that the original operation had no effect. This does not authorise another submission.
outcome.destination_blocked: The approved outbound network policy blocked the destination.
outcome.dns_unavailable: The destination could not be resolved safely.

inboxIntegrations.title: Integrations
inboxIntegrations.description: Connect approved services to a workflow using named inputs and selected field updates.
inboxIntegrations.permission: An administrator with general settings access manages integrations.
inboxIntegrations.loadError: Integrations could not be loaded. Retry to check the current configuration.
inboxIntegrations.saveError: We could not confirm the save. Your draft is kept. Refresh the list to check whether it saved before trying again.
inboxIntegrations.removeError: This integration could not be removed. Disable it instead if a workflow or unresolved operation still uses it.
inboxIntegrations.settingError: We could not confirm the dispatch setting. Refresh to check the current hold.
inboxIntegrations.saved: Integration settings saved. Previously reviewed work checks this revision again before dispatch.
inboxIntegrations.createdDisabled: Integration saved disabled. Review its configuration before enabling it. Workspace and host holds still apply.
inboxIntegrations.hostHeld: Your operator has held dispatch for this instance. Configuration and previews remain available.
inboxIntegrations.holdHelp: This control affects integrations only. It does not enable WhatsApp replies or SMS. An operation already in flight may finish.
inboxIntegrations.enableReview: Allow enabled integration definitions to dispatch queued work? Existing uncertain operations remain held for investigation. This does not enable automatic replies or SMS.
inboxIntegrations.noEndpoints: No approved destinations are registered. Ask your operator to register an exact HTTPS endpoint before creating an integration.
inboxIntegrations.emptyHelp: Define an approved action, then add it to a macro or disabled rule. Previews do not call the service.
inboxIntegrations.connectionHelp: Choose an operator-approved destination. Agents cannot enter URLs or custom headers in workflow actions.
inboxIntegrations.secretHelp: Credentials are encrypted and write-only. They do not appear in previews or history. Changing the destination or authentication may require a replacement credential.
inboxIntegrations.secretStored: A credential is stored. Its value cannot be read here.
inboxIntegrations.inputHelp: Use unique lowercase names with letters, digits and underscores. Each workflow maps a literal or a permitted variable to these inputs.
inboxIntegrations.noInputs: This integration sends an empty object.
inboxIntegrations.inputSchemaError: Each input needs a unique lowercase name using letters, digits and underscores.
inboxIntegrations.outputSchemaError: Use a unique lowercase property name and a different destination field for each output.
inboxIntegrations.outputHelp: Only these top-level response properties can update fields. The whole field batch is validated before it is applied; rich or executable output is not supported.
inboxIntegrations.fieldError: Field definitions could not be loaded. Retry before editing output mappings.
inboxIntegrations.noOutputs: No fields will be changed by this integration.
inboxIntegrations.referenceHelp: Optional top-level string property. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter (up to 64 characters). The value is retained as a reference; it changes a field only when explicitly mapped above.
inboxIntegrations.removeReview: Remove this integration definition? Referenced definitions and unresolved operations prevent removal. Recorded operations and recovery history are retained.
inboxIntegrations.catalogueError: Approved integrations could not be loaded. Retry before choosing a definition.
inboxIntegrations.obsoleteTitle: Mappings no longer in this definition
inboxIntegrations.obsoleteHelp: The input schema has changed. Remove obsolete mappings or choose the correct definition. Current mappings are kept until you explicitly remove them.
inboxIntegrations.referenceError: Use a lowercase property name starting with a letter, followed by letters, digits or underscores. Spaces, dots and hyphens are not allowed.
inboxIntegrations.noDefinitions: Ask an administrator to create a definition in the Integrations tab.
inboxIntegrations.definitionDisabled: This definition is disabled. Its intent can be reviewed, but it cannot dispatch.
inboxIntegrations.mappingHelp: Map named inputs using literals or permitted variables. Omit an optional input by leaving it empty. A value supplied by an earlier integration requires another review before use.

valueHelp.text: Text is sent exactly as rendered.
valueHelp.number: Enter a JSON number, such as 0 or 12.5, or a numeric variable.
valueHelp.boolean: Enter true or false, or a yes/no variable.
valueHelp.date: Use YYYY-MM-DD or a date variable.

inboxIntegrations.unavailable: This operation cannot dispatch in its current state.
inboxIntegrations.deferredHelp: The exact request is not yet known. After the earlier result is applied, review the actual values before this step can continue.
inboxIntegrations.deferredReply: This is a partial reply preview. Pending values are shown as an ellipsis. Review the exact message after the earlier integration completes:
inboxIntegrations.reviewUnavailable: This operation needs review. Refresh its current state or ask an administrator for help.

reason.integration_will_execute: The approved integration will run in action order after confirmation.
reason.prior_integration_result_requires_review: An earlier result supplies values for this action. It will pause for a fresh review before dispatch.
reason.integration_disabled: An administrator must enable this integration definition.
reason.dispatch_disabled: Workspace or host integration dispatch is held. Ask an administrator to review the hold.
reason.encryption_unavailable: Secure integration storage is unavailable. Ask your operator to restore the instance key.
reason.inputs_missing: Complete required inputs and any missing variables.
reason.inputs_invalid: Correct input names, types or variable syntax.
reason.endpoint_unavailable: The approved destination is no longer available. Ask an administrator to review this definition.
reason.permission_required: Your current permissions do not allow this integration.
reason.contact_field_permission_required: Updating contact fields requires contact read and write access.
reason.output_fields_unavailable: An output field is missing or archived. Ask an administrator to update the mapping.
reason.integration_unavailable: This integration could not be prepared. Refresh the case and review its configuration.
reason.required_details_from_integration: An earlier integration is expected to provide required details. Resolution checks the applied values again.

inboxNotice.title: Response alerts
inboxNotice.settingsHelp: Notify selected staff inside Whatomate when a response target is at risk or breached. This does not send email or customer messages, change assignments or alter deadlines.
inboxNotice.activationHelp: Only new threshold crossings are observed after activation. Re-enabling does not backfill older work. Changing recipients does not replay a recorded crossing.
inboxNotice.recipientsHelp: Choose up to 20 active staff. Each person must still have access to the exact case. Assigned agents receive only work they can read.
inboxNotice.directoryRequired: User-directory read access is required to browse staff names. Existing recipient references remain visible; ask an authorised administrator to review them.
inboxNotice.peopleFailed: Staff lookup failed. Your selected recipients are unchanged.
inboxNotice.assignedOnly: Only cases this person can access
inboxNotice.noPeople: No eligible staff on this page. Try another name or continue to the next page.
inboxNotice.invalidRecipients: Before enabling, choose at least one threshold and 1–20 eligible staff. Remove unavailable selections or ask an administrator to review them. You can always save notifications as disabled.
inboxNotice.conflict: Another administrator changed these settings. Refresh saved settings and review before saving again.
inboxNotice.unknownSave: The save outcome is unknown. Refresh saved settings before making another change. Do not repeat this save.
inboxNotice.saved: Notification routing saved. Response deadlines and customer replies are unchanged.
inboxNotice.loadFailed: Notification settings could not be loaded.
inboxNotice.accessRequired: Current full inbox and general-settings access is required. Ask an administrator to review your permissions.
inboxNotice.historyHelp: Available means retained in the app, not delivered to a person. Suppression and current access checks are recorded separately. This list contains only cases you can currently access.
inboxNotice.historyFailed: Observation history could not be refreshed.
inboxNotice.historyEmpty: No crossings have been observed. Notifications start disabled and do not backfill earlier thresholds.
inboxNotice.listHelp: Your internal response-target notices. Current work may since have been completed, paused or resolved. Acknowledging a notice does not reply to the customer or change the case.
inboxNotice.chatRequired: Your current workspace chat access does not permit this list. Ask an administrator to review your access, then reopen it.
inboxNotice.newActivity: New activity is available. Return to the first page to see the latest notices.
inboxNotice.listFailed: The list could not be refreshed. Displayed notices may be out of date.
inboxNotice.acknowledgeFailed: Acknowledgement could not be confirmed. Refresh the list before retrying; current case access may have changed.
inboxNotice.unreadEmpty: No unacknowledged notices on this page. Show all notices to review acknowledged work.
inboxNotice.listEmpty: No notices are available to you. An administrator must enable internal notifications and select you, and each case must remain within your access.
inboxNotice.acknowledgeSuccess: Notice acknowledged. Customer messages and case status are unchanged.

outcome.recipient_unavailable: Recipient unavailable or no longer eligible
outcome.case_access_denied: Recipient could not access this case
outcome.legacy_transfer_covered: Covered by the existing transfer escalation

inboxNotice.featureDisabled: Inbox workflows are disabled for this workspace. Ask an administrator to review the setting. Existing notice history is preserved.

inboxRouting.title: Routing policy
inboxRouting.help: Choose how this team shares new work in the selected inbox. Policies are templates until you review and apply them.
inboxRouting.useTeam: No inbox override; team settings apply
inboxRouting.unavailable: Selected policy is archived or unavailable
inboxRouting.saved: Policy saved; review it before applying
inboxRouting.alreadyApplied: The earlier application was recorded. Current settings have been refreshed.
inboxRouting.loadFailed: Routing settings could not be loaded. Retry to review the current configuration.
inboxRouting.incomplete: The policy list is incomplete. Refresh or ask an administrator to review it before applying a new selection.
inboxRouting.permissionChanged: Your routing permission changed. Refresh settings or ask an authorised team administrator.
inboxRouting.policyChanged: The policy changed or its name is already in use. Keep your draft and reload the current policy before retrying.
inboxRouting.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved. Check its values and retry; your draft is retained.
inboxRouting.previewFailed: The selection or its settings changed, or the review could not be prepared. Refresh and review the current policy and team members.
inboxRouting.reviewChanged: The review expired or its settings changed. Prepare a fresh review before applying.
inboxRouting.applyUncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Check and retry this same reviewed application; a recorded completion will not be applied twice.
inboxRouting.reviewExpired: This review has expired. Prepare a fresh review.
inboxRouting.unapplied: This template has a newer revision. Applied settings remain unchanged until you review and apply it.
inboxRouting.affectedAgents: Agents whose limits will be copied
inboxRouting.agentHelp: Select up to 100 current team members. The routing strategy covers this team and inbox; copied limits apply to each selected agent across their teams in this inbox.
inboxRouting.noAgents: Add an active team member before applying limits.
inboxRouting.tooManyAgents: Select no more than 100 agents for one application.
inboxRouting.unsavedCapacity: Save or discard the active-case limit edits above before reviewing a routing policy.
inboxRouting.templateHelp: Saving or archiving a template does not change applied settings. Apply a reviewed copy to the selected team, inbox and agents.
inboxRouting.replaceCapacity: Also replace selected agents' active-case limits
inboxRouting.activeHelp: Zero means Unlimited. Leaving replacement off preserves existing limits. Old unresolved Open and Pending cases still count.
inboxRouting.limitRate: Limit how many new assignments an agent receives
inboxRouting.rateHelp: A rolling window is measured backwards from each assignment check. It is separate from active workload. Re-saving the same owner does not consume another slot; genuine reassignment and supervisor overrides do. Turning the limit off does not erase assignment history.
inboxRouting.archiveHelp: Archive {name}? Applied settings and their copied limits remain in place. This template will no longer be offered for new applications.
inboxRouting.archiveFailed: The template changed or could not be archived. Refresh and review it before retrying.
inboxRouting.reviewHelp: Check the exact inbox, team and agents before applying. This changes assignment settings and sends no customer message.
inboxRouting.sharedLimits: Agent limits are shared across this agent's teams in the selected inbox. Existing assignments are retained; future assignments and reactivation recheck active capacity.
inboxRouting.reviewRechecks: Apply rechecks access, membership and the reviewed settings. Workload may change meanwhile; a new assignment is checked again when it happens.
inboxRouting.agentPermission: This agent needs Chat read and write access.
inboxRouting.automaticSetup: Automatic routing needs administrator review; manual assignment remains available.

inboxIntake.transportRequired: Choose WhatsApp and turn off SMS fallback on this step before using guided intake. Its existing transport settings have been preserved.
inboxIntake.summaryFailed: Intake results could not be loaded. Retry to review the handoff.
inboxIntake.summaryHelp: Only validated, unchanged fields are saved. Review saved values in the contact and case fields; handle missing or conflicting details before resolving.
inboxIntake.hiddenContactResults: Ask an authorised contact editor to review the contact field results.
inboxIntake.moreSummaries: The latest 50 intake handoffs are shown. Contact support if you need an older result.

outcome.invalid_value: Answer does not match the field type
outcome.definition_changed: Field definition changed since the request
outcome.permission_required: Editing permission is no longer available
outcome.flow_changed: Chatbot flow changed — no fields saved
outcome.consent_required: Consent was not confirmed — no fields saved
outcome.expired: Request expired — no staged answers retained
outcome.response_unverified: Reply could not be verified — no fields saved

inboxIntake.mappingUnavailable: Configured mapping is disabled or unavailable
inboxIntake.mappingAdminRequired: An administrator with flow and field editing access must configure guided intake.
inboxIntake.formStepHelp: Choose a reviewed mapping for this form's answer names, including a boolean consent answer. Fields are saved only at human handoff after validation and conflict checks.
inboxIntake.promptStepHelp: Choose a mapping with one answer input. The customer must quote this prompt when replying, and the session must already contain explicit boolean consent. Include a human handoff later in the flow. SMS transport and fallback are separate from intake.
inboxIntake.mappingsHelp: Map customer answers from chatbot prompts, reply buttons or WhatsApp forms to contact and case fields. Values are validated, staged securely and checked again at human handoff.
inboxIntake.mappingFieldsUnavailable: A destination field is archived or unavailable. Edit this mapping to choose a replacement.
inboxIntake.mappingLoadFailed: Intake mappings or field choices could not be loaded. Retry to review the current configuration.
inboxIntake.incompleteMappings: Only part of the mapping list was returned. Contact an administrator before changing configuration.
inboxIntake.mappingSaveFailed: The mapping could not be saved. Check your access, destination fields and consent key, then retry. Your draft is preserved.
inboxIntake.mappingConflict: This mapping changed since you opened it. Reload its latest version before saving; your draft is preserved until you choose to discard it.
inboxIntake.consentHelp: Use a named consent answer that is true only after the customer agrees to save their details. A missing, false or text answer does not grant consent.
inboxIntake.mapAnswersHelp: Use the form answer name, or answer for a prompt or reply button. Prompt and button answers must quote the original message. Empty answers never clear an existing field; No and zero are retained.
inboxIntake.answerRequired: Flag this answer if it is missing
inboxIntake.mappingValidation: Provide a name, consent key and 1–20 unique input/field pairs. Choose active destination fields. Names use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter; flow_token is reserved.
inboxIntake.enableMapping: Enable this mapping for configured chatbot steps
inboxIntake.createdDisabled: New mappings are saved disabled. Review the saved definition, then enable it and choose it on the chatbot step. Creating a mapping does not enable a bot or send a message.
inboxIntake.editEffect: Saving creates a new mapping revision. Unfinished responses using the older revision will not update fields. Disabling stops new collection and application; existing field values are retained.
inboxIntake.resolveTitle: Before a case can be resolved
inboxIntake.resolveHelp: Requirements are checked again when resolving. Missing details do not grant additional editing permissions; agents can hand the case to an authorised editor.
inboxIntake.scopeHelp: Account and team restrictions must both match. They always apply, including when the conditions below use Any.
inboxIntake.conditionHelp: Match the current priority or recorded contact/case fields. Empty differs from No and zero. All conditions must match unless you choose Any.
inboxIntake.conditionRequired: Choose at least one restriction or condition. Replace unavailable fields, accounts or teams before saving.
inboxIntake.choicesFailed: Account or team choices could not be loaded completely. Your draft is preserved. Retry before saving.
inboxIntake.conflict: This definition changed since you opened it. Your draft is preserved. Reload the latest definition before saving.
inboxIntake.emailHelp: Enter one email address without a display name or surrounding spaces. Empty values are allowed until required at resolution.
inboxIntake.urlHelp: Enter a full HTTPS link without embedded credentials. The link is stored only; the system does not open it.

inboxDiscovery.dateHelp: From and Through include the selected local dates. Activity means customer messages and human replies in this case; notes and delivery receipts do not move it.
inboxDiscovery.exactHelp: This view uses exact time boundaries. They stay unchanged unless you explicitly replace or clear them.
inboxDiscovery.navigationReset: Unavailable saved preferences were reset. Review the current queue before continuing.
inboxDiscovery.changed: Matching work changed. Your current page is preserved; refresh from the first page to see the latest results.
inboxDiscovery.invalidPage: This paging context is no longer valid. Refresh from the first page, or reset sort and dates.
inboxDiscovery.selectionRefresh: Refreshing clears the current case selection and bulk review.
inboxDiscovery.denied: You can no longer read this queue. Its displayed data has been cleared. Retry after restoring access, or choose another queue.
inboxDiscovery.historyTrimmed: Earlier navigation has been cleared to keep this session bounded.

orderHelp.priority_waiting: Urgent to low priority, then earliest entry into the human queue.
orderHelp.latest_activity: Most recent customer message or human reply in this case. Notes, status changes and receipts are excluded.
orderHelp.longest_unanswered: Oldest outstanding first or next human reply. Cases with no unanswered customer message appear last.
orderHelp.newest: Most recent entry into the human queue.
orderHelp.oldest: Earliest entry into the human queue.
orderHelp.nearest_deadline: Earliest current, incomplete and unpaused response target. Cases without a verified actionable deadline appear last.

error.timezone: Choose a valid IANA timezone, such as Africa/Johannesburg.
error.range: Through must be on or after From for each range.
error.skippedDay: That calendar date does not exist in the selected timezone. Choose another date.
error.dates: Enter valid calendar dates within the supported range. Through must be before 31 December 9999.
